enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and washing
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove pajamas. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making and eating a quick breakfast of toast and coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place on base. Press boil. Take mug from cupboard. Take bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Pour hot water into mug. Add coffee. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Put on plate. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Place dishes in sink. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing for work, packing a bag and checking the phone for program updates and the blackout warning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check program updates. Check blackout warning. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office in the city
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Get off bus. Walk to subway. Enter station. Tap card. Board train. Sit. Get off train. Walk to office. Enter building. Take elevator. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office: answering emails, coordinating community programs and calling partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Open program document. Update document. Call partner organization. Speak. Hang up. Call another partner. Speak. Hang up. Update volunteer spreadsheet. Send instant messages. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Continue emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Walk to elevator. Take elevator down. Exit building. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order lunch. Pay. Receive lunch. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Clear table. Walk back to office. Enter building. Take elevator up. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office: planning upcoming community events, scheduling volunteers and preparing materials
enriched_activities.desc: Open event plan. Review notes. Call venues. Email volunteers. Update volunteer schedule. Print materials. Collate materials. Staple materials. Place in folders. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send invites. File documents. Check supplies. Order supplies. Attend team meeting. Discuss logistics. Take notes. Return to desk.

Shut down computer. Pack bag. Stand up. Take elevator down. Exit building. Walk to subway. Enter station. Tap card. Board train. Sit. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner on the induction cooker and eating it before the evening peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and protein. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Chop protein. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off cooker. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes by hand and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Apply dish soap to sponge. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Scrub pan. Rinse pan. Place in drying rack. Scrub utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in drying rack. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Wipe counter. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, reading and keeping non-essential appliances switched off during the rolling blackout warning window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Check phone for time. Put phone down. Continue reading. Close book. Stand up. Check TV is off. Check air conditioner is off. Check game console is off. Check router is on. Walk back to sofa. Sit down. Pick up book. Open book. Continue reading.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night-time hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Comb hair. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and phone for personal admin, reviewing tomorrow's program schedule and charging devices while the fan runs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Pay bills online. Reply to personal emails. Review tomorrow's schedule. Make notes. Pick up phone. Review program schedule. Check messages. Plug phone into charger. Plug computer into charger. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Edit document. Save document. Close computer. Turn off phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading and turning off the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Turn page. Close book. Pick up phone. Press power button. Turn off phone. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Pull blanket. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.
